name: broadbanner-post-production
description: Production+ post-production for BroadBanner creators (post_production_distribution add-on). Turn a finished Substack live draft into a review: file its section, store and correct the transcript against the live roster, and generate the review in the brand/series voice. article-write drafts opinion pieces and essays; editorial-check (editor notes) and fact-check run independent second-agent checks of any draft. Everything lands as an editable portal DRAFT via the BroadBanner MCP connector.
